clue.text: Swimmer caught the flu — it's bad

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

indicators.note: bad suggests the letters of these words have gone wrong, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone stuck in bed with influenza, complaining that it's a nasty dose.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' rearranges THEFLUITS into UTTLEFISH, which follows C. The apostrophe in it's is ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: A marine cephalopod that propels itself through the sea is fairly called a swimmer.

clue.text: Ignores prunes!

definitions.meaning: to snub or deliberately overlook someone, as in refusing to greet them
trims back, as a gardener shortens branches

explanation.surface: A cheeky line about someone who won't touch dried plums.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are verbs: snubbing a person and trimming shrubs or budgets.

clue.text: Classified as revolutionary church in organised protest

indicators.note: in places the turned church letters inside the rearranged protest letters
organised means the letters of protest are put into a new order
revolutionary means turned round, so the church letters are read backwards

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A political radical's place in a carefully planned demonstration with the church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' looks like a description of the protester, but it is the reversal signal; 'organised' rearranges protest and the church letters split it after its fourth letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Documents restricted to the highest security level are described as classified.

clue.text: Temptation — eating last of garlic bread

indicators.note: eating means one piece takes another inside itself

parts.note: a lure is an enticement or temptation

indicators.note: last of picks the final letter of garlic

explanation.surface: The irresistible pull of garlic bread at dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Temptation' wants to be the definition; it is the outer piece, and 'bread' is slang for money.
explanation.definitionFit: Bread is slang for money, and filthy lucre is money in a disapproving sense.

clue.text: Dogs needing change of lead and restraints

indicators.note: lead here is the leading letter, which is swapped for a different one

parts.note: setters are breeds of gun dog

explanation.surface: Pet dogs that need a new leash and some way of holding them back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lead' looks like a dog's leash but means the first letter: S of SETTERS becomes F.
explanation.definitionFit: Fetters are chains or shackles for the ankles, so they are restraints.

clue.text: Rising protest must be admitted by state, sooner or later

indicators.note: admitted by means the turned piece is let inside the word for state

parts.note: to state is to say

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a demo is a protest march

explanation.surface: A growing protest movement that the state will have to recognise eventually.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'Rising' means the protest word reads upward, so it is reversed before going in.
explanation.definitionFit: At an unspecified future time, eventually: an adverb meaning the same as sooner or later.

clue.text: Boast of credit that hurt

parts.note: CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit
ow is the cry of someone in pain

explanation.surface: Bragging about praise that turned out to sting.
explanation.definitionFit: To crow is to brag or gloat, like a cockerel announcing itself.

clue.text: Creature in love depressed by case of rash

indicators.note: in a down clue, depressed by means placed below the other piece
the case of a word is its outer shell, its first and last letters

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: An animal in love whose spirits are dampened by a skin rash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'depressed' looks like low spirits, but in a down clue it means pushed underneath the other piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A large horned African or Asian beast is certainly a creature.

clue.text: Really fine at home — always

parts.note: well means in good health, fine
in means at home, as in staying in
ever means always, as in for ever

explanation.surface: Someone insists they are perfectly happy at home and always will be.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation of surprise, like 'Really!' or 'Goodness me!'

clue.text: Fish bite on river Tay with no trouble at first

parts.note: a sting is an insect's bite

indicators.note: with no means the following letter is taken away
at first takes the opening letter of trouble

explanation.surface: An angler on Scotland's Tay hooking a fish with no early difficulty.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tay is a Scottish river; removing T leaves AY.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat ray with a venomous barbed tail is a kind of fish.

clue.text: Subject offering latitude without resistance

indicators.note: without means the resistance letter is left out

parts.note: a tropic is a line of latitude, such as Cancer or Capricorn
R is the physics symbol for resistance

explanation.surface: A school subject that gives pupils freedom without pushback.
explanation.walkthrough: 'latitude' looks like freedom but is a line on the globe.
explanation.definitionFit: A subject of discussion or study is a theme or matter in hand.

clue.text: Event for a cyclist suffering after prison?

indicators.note: after places the suffering word behind the prison word

parts.note: doing time means serving a prison sentence
a trial is an ordeal, a source of suffering

explanation.surface: A rider in distress after a spell inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A race against the clock, ridden alone, is a standard cycling race format.

clue.text: Minister and bishop aim to protect first lady

indicators.note: to protect means the bishop letters surround the first lady

parts.note: RR is Right ..., the title of a bishop
Eve was the first woman in Genesis
an end is an aim or goal

explanation.surface: A cleric and a bishop setting out to shield a president's wife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first lady' suggests a president's wife, but it is Eve of Genesis.
explanation.definitionFit: A clergyman is a minister of religion, styled with this title.

clue.text: This girl may see Independent complaint rejected

indicators.note: rejected means turned back, so the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: a moan is a grumble or complaint

explanation.surface: A newspaper reader whose grievance was turned down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' reverses IMOAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A female given name, so a girl of that name is the one meant.

clue.text: Provides cover for tours and helps out

indicators.note: out means the letters are put out of place and rearranged

explanation.surface: A colleague who covers shifts on tours and lends a hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' shuffles TOURSHELPS.
explanation.definitionFit: Fitting padding and fabric to furniture gives it a covering.

clue.text: Copies may be run off initially in sections

indicators.note: in places the two opening letters inside the sections word

parts.note: parts are sections

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of each of run and off

explanation.surface: Duplicates that might be printed off in batches.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copies' is a verb here: the birds mimic speech, which is why the definition fits.
explanation.definitionFit: To mimic someone, repeating their words like a talking bird, is to copy them.

clue.text: Facing work, advance with energy

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
to posit is to advance or put forward an idea
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Confronting a task and pushing forward with vigour.
explanation.definitionFit: Facing, as in the house across the street, means situated directly across.

clue.text: Ready to move, covering a good distance

indicators.note: covering means the rearranged letters wrap around the other pieces
to move means the letters of ready are shifted about

explanation.surface: An athlete poised to set off and cover plenty of ground.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to move' turns READY into YARDE, which goes round AG.
explanation.definitionFit: Length measured in yards, as in American football gains, is a measure of distance.

clue.text: Anyone upset about party in Africa is a pest

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters go around the party
upset means the letters are knocked over and rearranged

parts.note: the ANC is the African National Congress, South Africa's governing party

explanation.surface: Someone annoyed by an African political party calls it a nuisance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns ANYONE into ANOYNE; with ANC 'about' it, letters are reordered to frame ANC.
explanation.definitionFit: A nuisance or irritant, in person or thing, is a pest.

clue.text: Firm backed to pressure US ink producer

indicators.note: backed means the firm abbreviation is turned back to front

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm
P is the physics symbol for pressure

explanation.surface: A company returning to put pressure on America's ink manufacturer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ink producer' suggests a printing firm; it is a sea creature that squirts ink.
explanation.definitionFit: This eight-armed cephalopod squirts a cloud of dark fluid to escape predators.

clue.text: Fruit may be an obligation when up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: an gives A
a must is something obligatory
as means when, as in 'as I left'

explanation.surface: Eating fruit becomes compulsory once you're out of bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses AMUSTAS.
explanation.definitionFit: A loose-skinned variety of mandarin orange is a fruit.

clue.text: Leading lady cheated, stifling urge

indicators.note: stifling means the cheated word smothers the urge word inside it

parts.note: done means cheated, as in 'I've been done'
a yen is a longing or urge

explanation.surface: A star actress who was swindled, suppressing a desire for revenge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leading lady' suggests a star actress; it means the senior woman in a field.
explanation.definitionFit: The most respected senior woman in a profession leads it in standing.

clue.text: Don keeps Phil off this creature

indicators.note: keeps means the name Don holds the other letters inside
off means the letters of Phil are out of order and rearranged

explanation.surface: Don stops Phil from going near some animal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' looks like keeping Phil away, but it signals that his letters are rearranged before Don holds them.
explanation.definitionFit: A playful marine mammal is the creature this clue points to.

clue.text: Design criteria can be a help for viewers?

definitions.meaning: a short form of specifications, the technical requirements of a design

definitions.text: can be a help for viewers?

explanation.surface: Wondering whether the brief for a design could help an audience.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are informal short forms: of specifications and of spectacles.

clue.text: Make certain, rejecting right result

indicators.note: rejecting means the right letter is thrown out

parts.note: to ensure is to make certain

explanation.surface: Advice to double-check, while refusing the correct outcome.
explanation.definitionFit: As verbs, both mean to follow as a consequence.

clue.text: No girls attracted to end of ancient furniture items?

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of ancient

parts.note: a group with no girls is all boys

explanation.surface: A boys-only crowd drawn to something very old.
explanation.walkthrough: Tall boys are high chests of drawers; the question mark marks the playful split.
explanation.definitionFit: High chests of drawers are pieces of bedroom furniture.

clue.text: Throw away travel game

parts.note: to bin something is to throw it away
to go is to travel

explanation.surface: Discarding a board game meant for car journeys.
explanation.definitionFit: A numbers-calling game of chance played on cards is a popular game.

clue.text: Calmly suggest removing contents to get sac

indicators.note: removing contents empties each word, leaving only its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Gentle advice to empty something out to obtain a pouch.
explanation.definitionFit: A closed membranous pouch of fluid in the body is a sac.

clue.text: Strange case — youth is one who's persuaded without effort

indicators.note: strange means the letters are made odd and rearranged

explanation.surface: An odd case of a young person who is easily talked round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strange' shuffles CASEYOUTH.
explanation.definitionFit: A person easily talked into lending money or agreeing is a soft target.

clue.text: Bar in American city supplying dope

indicators.note: in places the bar word inside the city abbreviation

parts.note: NY is New York
an inn is a pub with a bar

explanation.surface: A New York bar supplying illegal drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dope' suggests drugs; here it is a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: A dope is a fool or idiot, a silly person.

clue.text: Dish that's cooked for brood

definitions.meaning: a dish of meat and vegetables simmered slowly
to fret or worry, as in letting someone ...

explanation.surface: A meal prepared for a whole family of young.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a slow-cooked casserole; the other is to fret over something.

clue.text: Data seen in most unusual ecosystem

indicators.note: seen in means the data word appears inside the other

parts.note: rarest means most unusual
info is short for information, data

explanation.surface: Findings revealed in an extraordinary natural habitat.
explanation.definitionFit: Dense tropical woodland with high rainfall is a complex biological ecosystem.
